comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Fair warning: when you chart this zone for Mercator's world atlas, recognition/fishing will always leave you at 95/100 completion points. You either need to sink 15 NPC ships (15%), buy/sell at markets (15)%, or raise a shipwreck (45%) to finish charting of this zone.

comments.body: Same thing also in Gulf of Guinea and South Caribbean Sea
